note: No presentation. Per-member usage is the room owner's read, proved by a chain conferring `admin` that the room issued; the host's own administrators read it through the host's operator task, never through this one.
A page size of zero. A request for no entries is not a probe the host should answer; `limit` starts at 1.

An entry naming a member by something other than a DID. Usage is charged to the root subject of a room-issued chain, which is a DID; a display name or an account handle is host state this family never relies on.
An entry carrying a file name. The host never learns file names — they are sealed — and a usage report must not imply otherwise.
